title: Group scheduling for amateur sports clubs
thesis: Everyone complains about organising fixtures, so a tool for it should sell.
note: The trap: high complaint volume, a free alternative, no money anywhere.

evidence.title: Complaint thread about organising fixtures
evidence.body: Organising our weekly game is a nightmare. Everyone uses a different chat app and nobody replies to the poll.

evidence.title: Another complaint thread, different club
evidence.body: Same problem every week. We use a free group chat and a spreadsheet and it just about works.

evidence.title: Club secretary describes the workaround
evidence.body: I keep a spreadsheet and chase people by text. It costs nothing but my evening.

evidence.title: Existing free tool covers most of it
evidence.body: There is a free scheduling tool most clubs already use for polls, and nobody pays for anything beyond it.
